# neo4j

Neo4j openCypher access through the official drivers (Python, Java, Go, JavaScript) - bounded, anchored, parameterized queries, and EXPLAIN/PROFILE plans imported as dumps (AllNodesScan, CartesianProduct, fan-out).

## Recipes

- `apiforge model neo4j-access --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show neo4j`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-DATA-013, AF-GDB-004, AF-GDB-005, AF-GDB-006, AF-GDB-008, AF-GDB-024, AF-GDB-025
